title: Islam And Children
body:
As for children you must teach them to worship when they are seven years old - teach them to pray with you.
When they get to nine years old you must order them to pray - also when nine years old, boys and girls must
have seperate rooms and do not allow them to sleep in their parents room. That is also important for children.
What girls need to know, the mother must teach and what boys need to know the father must teach. Then
leave them to the Lord Almighty Allah saying "Oh our Lord, we have kept these children till now. After the
age of maturity you keep them. Protect them."
